name: securite
description: Website and live demo of securite, fast security middlewares for Rust (axum, hyper, tonic). Yew + WebAssembly front-end protected by its own WAF, rate limiter, CSP and more.

SECURITE_ENV.description: `production` enables the HTTPS redirect, HSTS, upgrade-insecure-requests and reads the client IP from Heroku's X-Forwarded-For.

RUST_LOG.description: Log filter (tracing). Security events use the `securite` target.
